title: salam khaak nasheeno pa sogwaro ka
body:
salam khaak nasheeno pa sogwaro ka
ghareeb dete hai pursa tumhare pyaro ka
<<DIVIDER>>
salam un pa jinhe sharm khaaye jaati hai
khule saro'n pe aseeri ki khaak aati hai
<<DIVIDER>>
salam us pa jo zahmat kashe salaasil hai
musibato'n me imamat ki pehli manzil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
salam bhejte hai apni shahzadi par
ke jisko sawnp gaye marte waqt ghar sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
musafirat ne jise bebasi ye dikhlayi
nisar kar diye bache na bach saka bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
aseer ho ke jise shaamiyo ke narghe me
husainiyat hai sikhaana ali ke lehje me
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina bibi tumhare ghulam haazir hai
bujhe jo pyas to ashko'n ke jaam haazir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sin, ye hashr ye sadme naye naye bibi
kaha'n pa baithi ho qaime to jal gaye bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
pahaad raat badi der hai sawere me
kaha'n ho shaam-e-ghareeba'n ke ghup andhere me
<<DIVIDER>>
zameen garm, yateemi ki saqtiya'n bibi
wo seena jis pa ke soti thi ab kahan bibi
<<DIVIDER>>
janaab-e-maadar-e-besheer ko bhi sab ka salam
ajeeb waqt hai kya de'n tasalliyo ka payaam
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi kaleje me ek aag si lagi hogi
abhi to godh ki garmi na kam hui hogi
<<DIVIDER>>
nahin andhere me kuch soojhta kaha'n dhundhen
tumhara chaand kaha'n chhup gaya kaha'n dhundhen
<<DIVIDER>>
na is tarah koi kheti hari bhari ujdi
tumhari maang bhi ujdi hai godh bhi ujdi
<<DIVIDER>>
nahi layeeno me insaa'n koi khuda hafiz
darinde aur ye be-waarisi khuda hafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
shareek-e-haq darood-o-salam-e-paighambar
salam sayyid-e-lawlaak ke lute ghar par
<<DIVIDER>>
salam mohsin-e-islam khasta tan laasho
salam tum pe shaheedo ke be kafan laasho
<<DIVIDER>>
salam tum pe rasool-o-batool ke pyaro
salam mehr-e-shahadat ke gird sayyaaro
<<DIVIDER>>
bache to agle baras ham hai'n aur ye gham phir hai
Jo chal base to ye apna salaam-e-aakhir hai
